In this series of 20 films, of 26 minutes each, the habitat will be a major showcase revealing our capacity to adapt ourselves at a time where we need to find solutions in order to address immense changes.

programme.title: Cosmic
programme.desc: In the wake of COVID19, students, doctors, engineers, from all around British Columbia, Canada, formed an Open Source community to create innovative PPE devices to limit the spread of the virus.

programme.title: Colonies Under the Sea
programme.desc: A visually stunning and fascinating documentary. A group of divers explore shipwrecks beneath the waves of the Bahamas archipelago.

programme.title: A Dog's Life
programme.desc: A Dog's Life explores the widely assumed facts that may actually be based on faulty and out-dated research. Ingenious experiments and meticulous observation reveal that the problems dogs solve best are those that involve interacting with humans. A fascinating and fun documentary that gives us 'a dog's eye view' on the world.

programme.title: Fundamentalism: Is There A Way Back
programme.desc: A growing counter-terrorist movement is gaining worldwide momentum.After the attacks in New York, London, Madrid and Bali as well as the assassinations in Toulouse carried out by Mohamed Merah, the world wonders about how these Islamists came to the point they were able to commit such atrocities: to kill in cold blood and be willing to die a Martyr's death. How and why did these young men become radicals? Is it reversible?In a number of countries, deradicalization programs have sprung up. Have they been successful? In this documentary, the first ever of its kind, reporters will meet with some Islamists – former terrorists – who have left the path of terror and now dedicate their lives to persuading other terrorists to do the same.

programme.title: Cheetah: The Price Of Speed
programme.desc: The cheetah is a highly specialised animal. It excels at one thing alone, running down high-speed prey faster than any other mammal on earth.But this specialisation comes at a cost. The cheetah as a predatory model seems focussed on one single area of expertise. Outside of pursuing prey, how effective is this animal when compared to the other apex predators of the savannah?Alongside lions, leopards, vultures and hyenas how does the cheetah fit into the efficient cogs of the savannah system? Can it compete, or is it an outsider, cornered by it's own specialisation?The primary character in the story is a cheetah mother, who goes about her daily life, hunting for her three cubs. Her trials and tribulations highlight the refined hunting system of the cheetah, but they also shed light on her weaknesses, and the lack of robustness in the species itself.

programme.title: The Boy From the Wild
programme.desc: Growing up on a Game Reserve meant to help wildlife get out of captivity, it shares how it began & how Peter Meyer survived some incredible moments in the wild.

programme.title: The Leopard's New Spots
programme.desc: The Leopard's New Spots is a documentary film about one man's mission to halt the alarming decline in southern Africa's leopard populations due to a widespread skin trade. Traditionally, only the Zulu royals have been allowed to wear leopard skins. However, in the last three decades the Shembe Church, a four million strong religious group, has adopted the skins into their ceremonial costume. The demand for leopard skins is now astronomical. Because the use of skins is so wide spread and culturally entrenched, law enforcement seems helpless to police this trade in a protected species. It has become, in one researchers words, 'a major conservation blind spot'. Leopard researcher Tristan Dickerson believes that you can't save the leopard without the support of the Shembe people. The film follows Dickerson as he travels from the heart of leopard country to the heart of Shembe and Zulu culture in an effort to discover a solution that benefits all parties. His best solution turns out to be fake fur. Bad fakes are commonly used by church members while they save for the expensive real thing. Dickerson believes that if he can produce a high quality, affordable fake fur, and gain the endorsement of the powerful leader of the Church he can turn the tables in favour of the leopard.

programme.title: Королевство кривых зеркал
programme.desc: Девочка Оля вечно не слушалась свою бабушку, капризничала, ленилась, вечно всего боялась. И вот однажды... Благодаря старому волшебному зеркалу Оля встречается с собственным отражением – девочкой Яло. Обе они попадают в Королевство кривых зеркал, где вообще нет обычных зеркал, потому что злые и не очень честные обитатели королевства желают казаться лучше, чем они есть на самом деле. Девочки, в конце концов, побеждают Зло, а для Оли, к тому же, путешествие в зазеркалье дало отличную возможность взглянуть на себя со стороны и приобрести прекрасные человеческие качества – самоотверженность, бесстрашие, верность друзьям…

programme.title: Друг на продажу
programme.desc: Гоша и Ваня - друзья с детства. Когда-то они сидели за одной партой, а теперь Иван - честный и неподкупный сотрудник ГИБДД, а Гоша - бизнесмен, готовый иногда идти на не вполне законные компромиссы. Когда у Гоши из-за его невнимательности прогорает его очередной бизнес, а от Вани уходит девушка, Гоше приходит в голову гениальная идея, с помощью которой всё можно исправить. Ничего не сказав Ивану, его друг публикует на сайте знакомств объявление, в котором Ваня представлен как мачо-миллионер, ищущий вторую половинку. За свидание с \"миллионером\" Гоша, как представитель брачного агентства, берет комиссию - 5 тысяч рублей, ну а дальше... все проблемы только начинаются.

programme.title: Секретный агент
programme.desc: Она — секретный агент мирового уровня. На этот раз ее задача — предотвратить биологическую атаку на Лондон. Вовлеченная в большую шпионскую игру, она неизбежно сталкивается с миром двойных стандартов, паранойи, безнаказанности и предательства. Вокруг так много друзей, но кому из них на самом деле можно доверять? И кто из них тот неуловимый "крот", которого она должна вычислить, чтобы остановить террористов? Чтобы спасти Лондон, ей самой придется играть не по правилам.

programme.title: Тихий Дон
programme.desc: Бессмертный роман Михаила Шолохова, отмеченный Нобелевской премией и вошедший в число наиболее ярких произведений мировой литературы, рассказывает о трагической ситуации, сложившейся в России в начале ХХ века, о сломанных Первой Мировой войной и революцией судьбах людей, о крушении устоев и идеалов донского казачества, о личной трагедии главного героя произведения - Григория Мелехова.

programme.title: Ночная смена
programme.desc: Макс теряет работу на заводе и, чтобы прокормить семью, вынужден согласиться на неожиданное предложение бывшей одноклассницы - поработать стриптизером. Скрывая новую профессию от жены Ани, Макс попадает в массу удивительных и нелепых ситуаций и в итоге теряет доверие любимой женщины. Стремясь вернуть мир и гармонию в семью, он обращается за помощью к коллегам из стрип-клуба, что и вовсе приводит к веселому хаосу...

programme.title: Кукушка
programme.desc: Сентябрь 1944 года, несколько дней до выхода Финляндии из Второй Мировой войны. Финскому снайперу-смертнику Вилле, прикованному к скале, удается освободиться от цепей. Капитан Советской армии Иван арестован СМЕРШем, и тоже только чудом остается в живых. Солдат враждующих армий приютила у себя на хуторе девушка Анни. Ни советский капитан, ни финский снайпер еще не знают, что Финляндия заключила перемирие с СССР и вышла из войны. Но для Анни они не враги, а просто мужчины. И все трое говорят на разных языках... Награды XXIV Московского Международного Кинофестиваля: Серебряный "Святой Георгий" Александру Рогожкину за лучшую режиссерскую работу, Серебряный "Святой Георгий" Виллэ Хаапасало за лучшую мужскую роль, приз ФИПРЕССИ за лучший фильм.

programme.title: Жизнь впереди
programme.desc: Жизнь впереди 18+ Чёрная комедия. 2017. Россия. Режиссёр: Карен Оганесян. В ролях: Светлана Ходченкова, Александр Паль, Павел Прилучный, Артур Смольянинов и др. Звёзды российского кино в чёрной комедии Карена Оганесяна Спустя годы выпускники 11 "Б" собираются вместе на похоронах одноклассника-тихони. С тех пор они очень изменились: хулиган стал сектантом, местная красотка — звездой, а неудачник — бизнесменом. Но теперь их былые чувства и обиды вспыхивают вновь.

programme.title: Агния
programme.desc: Своенравная печница Агния живет на Крайнем Севере в аварийном доме, ловит рыбу в проруби и в одиночку растит сына. Сезонная работа не позволяет ей накопить денег на новое жилье, а глава местной администрации Борис не торопится расселять остро нуждающихся в этом людей. Согласившись на предложение Бориса выложить печь, Агния использует его для достижения своей главной цели — поскорее переехать в долгожданную жилплощадь. И справляется она с этой задачей весьма нетривиальным способом.

programme.title: Всё и сразу
programme.desc: Тима и Дэн - друзья-неудачники из провинциального городка. Учеба позади, работать не тянет, девушек нет. На пути к мечте (выбиться в люди) и в надежде получить всё и сразу (без особого напряга) парни берутся выполнить задание местного бандюка и отправляются на дело, прихватив с собой автослесаря Жору, такого же полного лузера. На кону внушительная сумма, главное - не облажаться и чётко инсценировать ограбление своего же, подставного наркокурьера. Но вот засада: роль курьера случайно достаётся честному дембелю Ване, который оказывается не в курсе схем и обещаний. И теперь в водовороте погонь, потасовок и перестрелок всем четверым нужно по-настоящему напрячься, чтобы грамотно разрулить ситуацию. И получить ВСЁ и СРАЗУ.

programme.title: Бар "МоскваЧики"
programme.desc: Вика, Соня и Карина теряют устойчивое положение в Москве. Чтобы развеяться и подумать о будущем подруги уезжают в Петербург. После бурной ночной тусовки девушки, неожиданно для себя, покупают бар в историческом доме. Единственное неудобство - на втором этаже заведения находится квартира, а в ней своенравный жилец, который отказался выехать. Близкое знакомство с ним превращается в жестокое противостояние хозяек заведения и трёх молодых людей, у которых есть одна тайна на всех. Девушки очень не хотят отказываться от своего детища - бара \"МоскваЧики\", но сложностей с ним больше, чем они предполагали...

programme.title: The Humanity Bureau
programme.desc: In the near future, war, climate and political agendas have robbed America of its lush resources. Seeds rarely grow into vegetation, the water is mostly polluted, and people are obligated to work hard to earn their keep. Noah Kross (Nicolas Cage) is an agent of "the Humanity Bureau," a government agency that determines a person's productivity. Kross's reports are key factors in deciding who stays in America and who is deported to New Eden. Kross is in charge of managing the deportation of a former governor of Colorado who now lives in misery, who claims to know "the truth" before seeking to kill Kross and then being shot by him. Kross ends up discovering that New Eden is really an extermination camp where the excess unproductive population is liquidated and incinerated.

programme.title: The Zodiac
programme.desc: THE ZODIAC takes a different look at the famous Zodiac Killer case from other screen treatments of the murders. More than a simple crime story, the film is an emotional thriller focusing on the murders' impact on victims, their families and the wider community. The film follows a police detective and his son who become obsessed with the murders and endanger their family in the process.

programme.title: The Adventure Scouts
programme.desc: A coming of age movie about a group of boys and girls called "adventure scouts" who return from a camping trip to discover their small town is being held captive by a gang of motorcycle-riding knuckleheads. Using only their scouting knowledge and camping equipment, the kids take down the gang members one by one, reunite with family members, and restore the community's sense of pride.

programme.title: Raspberry Magic
programme.desc: "Raspberry Magic" is a coming-of-age story about 11-year-old Monica Shah, who thinks she must win the science fair in order to bring her father back after he runs out on the family. She blames herself for her parents' problems, and takes charge when her mother falls into a deep depression. Set behind the backdrop of a beautiful forest, Monica's experiment uses touch therapy to help raspberries grow faster. She asks, is it nature or nurture that can truly help a being grow? Does it even matter? Through her ups and downs with her family, she learns that it's a complex question, and the answer isn't so simple.

programme.title: Mayor Cupcake
programme.desc: A hard-working cupcake maker is inadvertently elected mayor of a small town burdened with debt. With no formal experience or education to speak of, she must rely on her street smarts to clean up the town.

programme.title: The Lucky Dragon
programme.desc: A young, Chinese dragon punished by the gods to be a mere mortal is cast down to earth. He is forced to make his way in a strange land until the evil forces discover his true identity. Take part in a world full of imagination while following the journey of a mischievous dragon who has been transformed by magic into a little boy and exiled from his home to live among humans. When both good and evil forces learn that a dragon has arrived, they look for him as he is the only one who can find the magical sword—whose owner can rule the universe! Will he find the sword in time before it gets into the wrong hands? Will he ever become a dragon again?

programme.title: Railroad Tigers
programme.desc: In December 1941, Japan expands the occupation of its neighbouring countries to Southeast Asia. The railway from Tianjin to Nanjing in East China became a key military transportation route, heavily guarded by Japanese soldiers. Railroad worker Ma Yuan (Jackie Chan) leads a team of freedom fighters. Using his deep knowledge of the train network, he and his men sabotage it, ambushing Japanese soldiers and stealing supplies to feed the starving Chinese. Although the freedom fighters have no weapons of their own, they employ whatever tools are at hand, including a hammer and shovels, loose railway track planks and diverted trains. The local Chinese call the unlikely heroes the "Railroad Tigers". The freedom fighters find themselves on the wrong side of the tracks when the Japanese send reinforcements to Shandong. In an act of defiance, Ma Yuan launches his most dangerous mission yet, blowing up a heavily guarded railroad bridge. When the Japanese learn of the crippling plan, which will derail the war effort, the stakes are raised even higher. After many missed opportunities and missed shots, the bridge is blown up by the ragtag Chinese railroad tigers.

programme.title: Saving Lincoln
programme.desc: Director Salvador Litvak and his writing partner, Nina Davidovich Litvak, based their screenplay on their extensive research into Lincoln's friendship with Lamon. ''Saving Lincoln'' charts their relationship from their initial meeting to Lincoln's Presidency. Lamon was a tall, boisterous Southerner who liked to drink whiskey, tell jokes and stories, play the banjo, and wrestle. Despite some pronounced differences between the two men, they shared a fondness for telling jokes and stories, and both felt slavery should be eliminated. Lamon often served as Lincoln's private confidant.

programme.title: Headwinds
programme.desc: Sarah tells Paul that she wants out of their marriage; the next day she disappears. A year later and Paul along with their children return to his childhood town to start anew after the loss of his wife and their mother.

programme.title: The Sandman
programme.desc: One fine morning, Benno finds sand in his bed. While he tries to ignore this at first, he soon must realize that he himself is loosing the sand. Day after day the sand increases and soon his time literally starts running short. Finally he is left no choice but to ask Sandra for help, who runs a small coffee shop under his apartment. Although Benno hates her with a passion, he started having dreams of her every night. What could Sandra and the dreams have to do with the sand?

programme.title: Caesar
programme.desc: Epic look at Julius Caesar, Rome's last dictator, whose death also signaled the end of the Roman Republic. Chronicles his campaigns in Gaul and Egypt, his rivalry with General Pompey, and his eventual assassination at the hands of Brutus and Cassius.

programme.title: Noble Things
programme.desc: Jimmy Wayne Collins finds himself adrift in Memphis, Tennessee. Forced to return home to the piney woods of Southeast Texas, Jimmy will face his imprisoned brother, his dying father and the demons he left behind.

programme.title: Deserter
programme.desc: Unlikely friends in a melting pot of confusion. Simon Murray fights for the French Foreign Legion. Pascal Dupont fights for himself. War torn men question honour, hope, morality...because you can desert everything...except yourself.

programme.title: Looks That Kill
programme.desc: Max Richards, a teenage boy born with a medical condition of being lethally attractive, who is changed forever when he meets Alex, a girl with her own bizarre ailment, who aids him on his quest of self-discovery... without accidentally killing someone.

programme.title: The Groomsmen
programme.desc: A 30-something man decides to marry his pregnant girlfriend and asks his four best friends to stand with him at the wedding, but as he observes his friends relationship troubles, he wrestles with issues of fatherhood, marriage and growing up.

programme.title: Armastuse teekond
programme.desc: Ellie on kaua ja kaunikesti aidanud oma õel pulmi planeerida. Külalised on vaikselt rannahotelli kokku kogunema hakanud, kuid keda kohal pole on pruutpaar. Juhtumisi on isameheks Ellie ekspeika Greg, kellega tuleb nüüd kiirelt plaab B välja mõelda, et külalised maha rahustada. Pulmapäev läheneb ohtliku kiirusega. Ellie ja Greg peavad kriisiolukorras tihedat koostööd tegema ja ühtäkki hakkavad nad taasavastama, miks nad ise kunagi teineteisesse nii armunud olid.

programme.title: Soosik
programme.desc: Iirimaa, Suurbritannia,USA 2018 komöödia, draamaLavastaja:Yorgos LanthimosOsades:Emma Stone, Rachel Weisz, Nicholas Hoult18. sajandi hakul on pea kõik Inglismaa mehed hõivatud üksteise mahanottimisega Hispaania pärilussõjas. Kummalisel kombel haigestunud kuninganna Anne (Veneetsia festivalil parima naisnäitleja auhinna võitnud Olivia Colman) igavleb luksuslikus palees oma voodis. Tema naeruväärse imetluse on pälvinud 17 armsat jänkukest ja ta osaleb alati ekstravagantsetel meelelistel üritustel, kuid lükkab olulisemad kohustused oma ustava sõbranna Sarah (Oscari-võitja Rachel Weisz) kaela. Marlborough' hertsoginna kutsub palee toateenijaks veetleva, kuid ujeda nõbu Abigaili (Oscari-võitja Emma Stone). Petlikuna näiv kuninglik rahu ja peomeeleolu ei jää aga kauaks kestma, kui need kolm kuritahtlikku ja kalki naist hakkavad tunnetama armastuse varjatud piire eri moel.

programme.title: Otsus lahkuda
programme.desc: Mees on kaljult alla kukkunud ja surma saanud. Juhtumi tagamaid uurivale inspektorile Hae-joonile tundub veider see stoiline rahu, millega naine pealtnäha traagilise teate vastu võtab. Pärast tema esialgset ülekuulamist usub mees, et naisel on varjata rohkem, kui ta usutluse käigus avaldas, ning asub naist kui kahtlusalust jälgima.

programme.title: Sa pole sina
programme.desc: Romantiline komöödia jutustab Pariisi ärireisile sõitnud perekonnast ja sügisel abielluda kavatsevast noorpaarist, kelle elu muutub peagi. Noort meest paelub imetabane Pariis ja illusioon, et "kusagil mujal on elu alati parem".

programme.title: Tugevam
programme.desc: Inspireeriv tõestisündinud lugu tavalisest mehest Jeff Baumanist, kes võitis kodulinna ja maailma südamed, kui temast sai 2013. aasta Bostoni maratoni plahvatuste järel lootuse sümbol. Jake Gyllenhaali kehastatud 27-aastane töölisklassist Bostoni elanik Jeff oli maratonil, et võita tagasi endist tüdruksõpra Erinit. Ta ootab plahvatuse hetkel finišijoonel ja kaotab seetõttu mõlemad jalad. Jeff aitab haiglas teadvusele tulles politseinikel üht pommipanijat tuvastada, kuid tema enda lahing on alles alanud.

programme.title: Sugupoolte heitlus
programme.desc: Lugu tennisetäht Billie Jean Kingist, kes võitleb 70ndatel selle eest, et naistennisistidele makstaks sama palju kui meestennisistidele. Tõestamaks, et naised ei ole ainult kööki mõeldud, peab ta pidama maha tennisemängu 55-aastase pensionil oleva meestennisistiga, kes on avalikult ja uhkelt suur šovinist.

programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: Женский доктор
programme.desc: Действие разворачивается в новой современной клинике, которую основал профессор Юрий Климов. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

programme.title: Скажи мне правду
programme.desc: В центре сюжета – история обычной домохозяйки Анастасии. Ее благополучный мир, который она с такой любовью выстраивала, оказывается под угрозой: мужа Игоря арестовывают, а у маленькой дочки обнаруживают тяжелую болезнь. Настя не сдается и делает все, чтобы помочь близким. Но внезапно она узнает об изменах Игоря – и это становится для нее жестоким ударом. Как наша героиня поступит: простит супруга или начнет жизнь с чистого листа?

programme.title: Дневники Темного
programme.desc: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

programme.title: At Dawn
programme.desc: At Dawn is an atmospheric one-off documentary that explores the powerful symbolism of daybreak. As the first light touches different landscapes and lives, the film captures moments of silence, movement, and emotional transformation. With a calm visual style and reflective narrative, it looks at how a new day can represent hope, memory, resilience, and renewal. The documentary invites viewers to slow down and observe the world in its most delicate and meaningful hours.

programme.title: Clash of the Gods
programme.desc: Documentary series that in each episode explains the heroic and tragic life of various figures from Greek and Norse mythologies - the most powerful monsters, heroes and Gods, including Thor, Hercules, Beowulf, Minotaur, Odysseus and Zeus. Was ancient Greece's greatest hero Hercules a real person? What inspired the Minotaur's labyrinth? Did Odysseus's famous journey really happen? This series will answer these and many other questions, and experts will connect the myths we all know to actual historical events, and link the stories to mythologies of other cultures as well.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: Lost Worlds
programme.desc: Documentary series that brings back to life lost cities, structures, cultures, and civilisations, transporting viewers back in time and revealing the truth behind some of history's most iconic eras. Using a combination of cutting-edge technology and archaeological research, the team detail what life was like for these places during their peak of their powers, and use visual overlays to compare past and present landscapes. From the Knights Templar to the lost city of Atlantis, ancient Egypt to Hitler's planned supercity, and ancient Athens to America's wild west, each episodes dives into these extraordinary remnants of human history.

programme.title: Bible Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: Documentary series in which viewers have a chance to explore the mysteries and reveal secrets and hidden facts of the world's most famous and oldest book - the Bible. For thousands of years, The Holy Bible has been the foundation on which Judaism and Christianity are built, but there are still many secrets and things which can be interpreted differently. Featuring stunning on-location photography, interesting reenactments and interviews with scientists, archaeologists and religious leaders, this series will take us on remarkable journey back in time to see what the Old Testament and the New Testament are hiding from us - from Dead Sea Scrolls, examinations of the traditional belief that Moses wrote the Torah, to whether Adam and Eve were created together or one before the other, who authored the New Testament and many other mysteries.

programme.title: Digging for the Truth
programme.desc: Digging for the Truth was a History Channel television series. The first three seasons of the show focused on host Josh Bernstein, who journeyed on various explorations of historical icons and mysteries. Bernstein is the president and CEO of BOSS and has a degree in anthropology and psychology from Cornell University. The show airs every Monday night at 9:00 EST on the History Channel. The series premiered in January, 2005 and has since become the highest-rated series in the history of The History Channel, which was surprising given the previous show "Time Titans" from the production crew never made it past the pilot. The third season premiered on January 22, 2007, with a 2-hour special event on the quest for Atlantis. Bernstein announced on February 20, 2007, that he would be leaving The History Channel and Digging for the Truth, and would, as of April, join The Discovery Channel as an executive producer and host of a new prime-time series and specials. Hunter Ellis, host of Tactical to Practical and Man, Moment, Machine for The History Channel, then replaced Josh Bernstein as host.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: From The History Channel : "Myths and legends have long been regarded as fantastic stories that describe powerful gods, mutant giants and fearsome monsters. But why do so many different cultures, separated by vast distances, tell the same stories? Is it possible that myths and legends were really eyewitness accounts of ancient astronauts descending to Earth? Ancient texts are filled with stories of gods interacting with humans, offering wisdom, technology, and even impregnating women. Could the demigods of mythology have been the offspring of alien and human unions? If so, could aliens have supplied the Missing Link that accelerated human evolution, advancing our civilization and making us who we are today?"

programme.title: Cities of the Underworld
programme.desc: While most people think of San Francisco as a haven for peace-loving hippies, this city by the Bay is actually one of the biggest military defense installations in America. We'll take you beneath its picturesque hills and uncover the biggest ammunitions depot on the West Coast before plunging into a deadly arsenal that once stored nuclear missiles with more than six times the destructive power of the atom bomb dropped on Hiroshima. From the secret Civil War fortification buried beneath Alcatraz to the human trafficking tunnels winding below Chinatown, San Francisco's underground is evidence of its sordid past.

programme.title: Project Impossible
programme.desc: Project Impossible is an original series that follows a new generation of epic engineering projects that were considered unthinkable just a few years ago. Each episode of Project Impossible features multiple stories that illustrate man-made projects that are crucial to our future. These projects include a massive North Sea wind station with 600-foot rotors, a giant sea wall that will protect the ancient city of Venice from rising waters, the world's largest moveable structure in Chernobyl, and the construction of a fleet of nuclear powered icebreaking ships.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: From The History Channel : "Mysterious places can be found around the Earth, and, inexplicably, UFOs are often sited near these mystical areas. Planes and ships unaccountably disappear in the infamous Bermuda Triangle. Strange magnetic anomalies in Mexico's Zone of Silence have not only drawn missiles off their course, but seem to pull meteorites out of the sky. An ancient doorway carved into a sheer rock wall in Peru's Puerta de Hayu Marka is said to be a portal to other worlds. Markawasi's plateau is filled with strange rock formations allegedly left behind by an ancient advanced civilization. What connections do these and other "hot spots" share? Is it possible that ancient extraterrestrials also knew about these mysterious places?"

programme.title: Cities of the Underworld
programme.desc: In major cities around the world today, skyscrapers loom overhead, taxis honk their horns and street vendors peddle their wares. But below lies city upon city - each with its fascinating and unknown history. This series will explore these layers, which are often hundreds of feet deep, and examine a city's ancient cisterns, dank dungeons, eerie tombs, clandestine hideouts, and even underground shipwrecks that have been lost for hundreds and hundreds of years. What are the underground layers of the most populated cities on earth? And how did (and do) engineers build layer upon layer up to today's city streets? This series will reveal the technological marvels that allowed the construction of one city upon another - literally.

programme.title: Project Impossible
programme.desc: In the past 50 years, the world's energy use has doubled. In the next 50 years, it will double again. Can we keep up with demand - or will we plunge into darkness? Across the world, engineers are going to extreme lengths to keep the lights on: harnessing the power of the longest river on Earth, tapping into the raging heat of a live volcano, and building one of the largest offshore wind facilities in the world. This is Project Impossible: Battling the Blackout.

programme.title: Clash of the Gods

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: From The History Channel : "Unearthly visitations, Heavenly messengers, and Close encounters. Accounts of humans interacting with celestial beings have existed since the beginning of mankind. Many of these encounters resulted in moral, philosophical and artistic inspirations. Did these contacts involve ethereal beings from heaven or extraterrestrials from other worlds? Are holy books the word of God, or guidebooks passed down by more advanced civilizations? Who told Joan of Arc how to defeat the English Army, ethereal saints or physical extraterrestrials? Could a young boy from India have learned advanced mathematical formulas, as he claimed, from a Hindu goddess? What message did an American serviceman receive while touching an alien aircraft? If the Ancient astronaut theory is correct, then are beings from other worlds communicating with us for our benefit... or theirs? Just what is the purpose of these alien contacts?"

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: Beyond Oak Island
programme.desc: From the producers of "The Curse of Oak Island" and "The UnXplained" comes an exciting new documentary series, "Beyond Oak Island." Hosted by real-life treasure hunters Rick and Marty Lagina, this eight episode series chronicles the greatest treasure hunts of the past, present and (perhaps) future. "Beyond Oak Island" offers a combination of great story telling, compelling interviews with treasure-hunters, historians and experts, as well as on-location treasure hunts in progress, sometimes with the Laginas themselves. From pirates such as Blackbeard and outlaws like Jesse James, to Aztec gold, priceless historical artifacts from American history and sunken treasure ships, "Beyond Oak Island" digs deep into the many treasure quests across the globe, revealing amazing new details and clues from past searches - and in some cases, advancing the hunt.

What are the underground layers of the most populated cities on earth? And how did (and do) engineers build layer upon layer up to today's city streets? This series will reveal the technological marvels that allowed the construction of one city upon another - literally.

programme.title: Project Impossible
programme.desc: In the past 50 years, the world's energy use has doubled. In the next 50 years, it will double again. Can we keep up with demand - or will we plunge into darkness? Across the world, engineers are going to extreme lengths to keep the lights on: harnessing the power of the longest river on Earth, tapping into the raging heat of a live volcano, and building one of the largest offshore wind facilities in the world. This is Project Impossible: Battling the Blackout.

programme.title: Clash of the Gods
programme.desc: Documentary series that in each episode explains the heroic and tragic life of various figures from Greek and Norse mythologies - the most powerful monsters, heroes and Gods, including Thor, Hercules, Beowulf, Minotaur, Odysseus and Zeus. Was ancient Greece's greatest hero Hercules a real person? What inspired the Minotaur's labyrinth? Did Odysseus's famous journey really happen? This series will answer these and many other questions, and experts will connect the myths we all know to actual historical events, and link the stories to mythologies of other cultures as well.

programme.title: Утро
programme.desc: Утренняя новостная программа Настоящего времени.

programme.title: Азия 360
programme.desc: В отдаленном селе Зардалы Баткенской области живут 30 семей, в основном это пожилые люди. Село находится в 10 километрах от районного центра, но до сих пор здесь нет электричества, дороги, а люди добираются в село по опасной горной тропе, зимой нередко срывались с обрыва. Местное население все еще ждет, когда их обеспечат светом и связью и построят безопасную дорогу. В августе 1999 года здесь произошло самое крупное военное столкновение с боевиками ИДУ. Жители были взяты в заложники почти на месяц. Покажем быт людей и расскажем о воспоминаниях событий 20-летней давности. И еще расскажем о том, как этот поселок стал признанным на мировом уровне самым экологичным районом, где выращивают экопродукты.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека
programme.desc: Закоренелый холостяк Чарли, постоянно опасающийся за свою свободу, и его брат Алан, недавно разошедшийся с женой, живут под одной крышей. Чарли только и делает, что заводит любовные интрижки, а Алан всеми силами пытается от него не отстать. В свободное от амурных приключений время братья воспитывают десятилетнего сынишку Алана Джейка.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека
programme.desc: Закоренелый холостяк Чарли, постоянно опасающийся за свою свободу, и его брат Алан, недавно разошедшийся с женой, живут под одной крышей. programme.title: Встречная полоса
programme.desc: Автомобильная авария переворачивает жизнь Крапивиных навсегда. Игорь попадает в больницу с сильной травмой головы, а его жене Любе открывается шокирующая правда. Оказывается, ее любимый муж ей изменяет. Об этом Люба узнает из сообщений, которые приходят на телефон Игоря от его молодой любовницы Ники. Люба оказывается перед серьезным выбором — открыть ли правду об измене мужа семье? Нужно ли признаться любовнице мужа, что Люба в курсе их отношений? И, наконец, как поступить — бороться за жизнь Игоря или бросить его?

programme.title: Чемпионат Европы по водным видам спорта
programme.desc: С 10 по 16 августа в Париже будут разыграны медали чемпионата Европы по плаванию в 50-метровом бассейне. В программе предварительных заплывов: 50 м, баттерфляй, женщины; 100 м, вольный стиль, мужчины; 100 м, брасс, женщины; 200 м, спина, мужчины; смешанная эстафета, 4х100 м, комплекс; 800 м, вольный стиль, мужчины. В соревнованиях участвуют эстонские пловцы Маргарет Марквардт, Маари Рандвали, Сийм Кескюла, Ларс Кулюс, Энели Ефимова и Эгле Салу. Сборная Эстонии также участвует в смешанной комплексной эстафете 4х100 метров. Комментирует трансляцию Дмитрий Пютсепп.

programme.title: Утро
programme.desc: Утренняя новостная программа Настоящего времени.

programme.title: Неизвестная Россия
programme.desc: Говорят, что качество жизни в России напрямую связано с близостью к Москве: чем ближе к Садовому кольцу, тем лучше жить. А поэтому считается, что жители Подмосковья - относительно счастливые люди, ведь они находятся неподалеку от центра российской вселенной. Со всеми обязательными удобствами - электричеством, водопроводом и газом. Но обычный автомобиль, словно фантастическая машина времени, за пару часов может переправить в далекое прошлое. Туда, где людей все еще греет огонь. А газ остается непостижимой голубой мечтой.

programme.title: Азия 360
programme.desc: Город Баткен — родина насвая. Это традиционный табачный продукт в странах Центральной Азии, производимый в основном в домашних условиях. В Баткене большинство взрослых мужчин употребляют жевательный табак с раннего возраста. Если насвай для местных это традиционный продукт, то иностранцев он удивляет. Несмотря на запрет на использование насвая в странах таможенного союза, его производство в Киргизии не прекратится — ни один закон не запрещает его использование.

programme.title: Нарисуй меня счастливой
programme.desc: Люба выросла в детдоме, рано вышла замуж и также рано овдовела. Её муж вёл разгульную жизнь — пил, играл в карты и в итоге погиб в драке. Люба была вынуждена браться за любую работу, чтобы обеспечить взрослую дочь Леру и властную свекровь Анну Борисовну. Теперь, несмотря на свой художественный талант, Люба работает маляром. На ней держится весь дом, но семья совсем не ценит её усилия. На Любу обращает внимание Антон Павлович — хозяин дома, где она делает ремонт. А вскоре за Любой начинает ухаживать приезжий электрик Самир. Однако дочь и свекровь делают всё, чтобы помешать её счастью. Когда Люба осознаёт, что родным нужны от неё только деньги, она решает уйти из дома…

programme.title: Госпожа Фазилет и ее дочери
programme.desc: Госпожа Фазилет после того, как потеряла мужа, одна воспитывает двух дочек. Вся жизнь Фазилет прошла в сожалениях, поэтому теперь ее вкладом в будущее стала младшая дочь Эдже. Но самым большим препятствием на пути матери является старшая дочь Хазан, которая несмотря на свою изысканную красоту ведет себя по-мальчишески и не ладит с матерью. Семья Эймен богата, могущественна, у них особняк на берегу Босфора, и однажды их пути пересекаются с Фазилет и ее дочерьми. Богатство Эймен даже превосходит мечты Фазилет. После знакомства с ними изменится не только жизнь Эдже, но и Хазан, которая влюбится в Синана Эймена, избалованного сына семьи.

programme.title: Лицом к событию
programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Ольга
programme.desc: Главная героиня воспитывает двух детей от разных браков, заботится об отце-алкоголике и пытается наладить личную жизнь. Старшая дочь Анька учится в ПТУ, думает, что она единственный адекватный член семьи и в её жизни все будет по-другому, младший сын Тимофей, чей отец вернулся к первой семье в Азербайджан, считает, что он уже мужчина, хотя ему всего лишь 11 лет, отец Ольги, бывший футболист, крепко выпивает и постоянно врет, а сестра Ленка пытается жить за счет мужчин, в основном — женатых. Вечно спасая родственников от неприятностей, Ольга живет чужой жизнью и редко думает о себе — до тех пор, пока в нее не влюбляется молодой и положительный водитель газели "Ритуал" Гриша.

programme.title: Голое влечение. Польша
programme.desc: Скандальный цикл передач, в которых люди находят потенциальных спутников жизни, обнаженные тела которых им показывают. Затем они должны будут сами раздеться и сделать выбор.

programme.title: Анатомия убийства
programme.desc: Карского приглашают в город, где готовят к постановке его пьесу. Он просит Евгению поехать с ним, заодно и отдохнуть. Однако уже в первый день в театре происходит убийство, и Женя вынуждена начать расследование. История закрученная, но её талант по мельчайшим деталям докапываться до истины помогает местной полиции выйти на преступника. Вскоре в краеведческом музее находят труп девушки, и вновь Евгения помогает в расследовании. А тем временем пьеса готова к премьере, и Карский должен присутствовать на мероприятии. В доме, где им предоставили прекрасные апартаменты, тоже происходят загадочные события. Местный следователь Алина Богомолова очень высоко ценит работу патологоанатома, которая в свой отпуск помогает во всех расследованиях.

programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: Hosted by Erin Burnett, an expert in political science and economics, OutFront is an hour-long news programme examining the latest stories from the US and further afield. Broadcast live from either the New York studio or live on location from the site of a breaking story, the show features insightful opinions from informed guests. With expert analysis from CNN's correspondents and analysis from the show's panel, Erin Burnett OutFront dissects the stories of the day, leaving no stone unturned. Burnett, a former financial analyst for Goldman Sachs, uses her forthright approach to engage interviewees in honest discussion.

programme.title: Anderson Cooper 360
programme.desc: Anderson Cooper delves into the day's news, looking beyond the broadcast to give his take, prompting us to re-think what we hear in the headlines. Cooper has covered major, international stories like the aftermath of Hurricane Katrina on the Gulf Coast, the catastrophic BP oil spill and the 2010 earthquake in Haiti, which saw the whole world fall silent. The show has won an absolute plethora of awards over the years, including GLAAD Media and Emmy awards.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Nicole arranges a playdate for Anais with the son of a classy lady she met at the supermarket. / Richard has lost all of the family's money. Nicole is happy for the Wattersons to appear in a Joyful Burger commercial for some much needed cash. / Darwin joins the school marching band and his tin-whistle talent lands him the solo. / Rob creates a variety of spinoff Elmore shows and formats in order to replace Gumball.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

Craig, Kelsey, JP and the Williams family - without Bernard - all head to the beach for some fun, but Craig starts to feel uncomfortable when his friends begin having more fun with his father Duane than with him. Craig intends to keep Kelsey and JP to himself, and he achieves this when they discover a treasure map that could lead to buried treasure.

programme.title: Clarence
programme.desc: Follow the daily adventures of a 10-year-old boy named Clarence, and his two best friends Sumo and Jeff. Clarence lives with his mother Mary and her boyfriend Chad in the fictional town of Aberdale, and he is optimistic, curious, honest and quirky boy, who sees the best in everyone and gets himself in a variety of funny situations and everyday problems, which he solves with lots of imagination and with the help from his friends.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: "When Alan ditches Gumball to do something more fun Gumball is desperate to track him down and make him pay for his betrayal. Gumball has through gritted teeth prepared a special dinner for Alan to apologise for the way he has treated him in the past. Gumball tracks down the traitor to give him a piece of his mind but when he finds out his Mom really is sick he has to find a way to make it up to him.

programme.title: Total DramaRama
programme.desc: Total DramaRama is canadian animated comedy series, spin-off of Total Drama, all characters are already well-known and loved by the audience. This time Duncan, Gwen, Courtney, Izzy, Noah, Bridgette and the rest find themselves in the past as kids and their adventures take place in kindergarten. The strict Chef Hatchet is there to keep his eye on them. Any harmless idea of the kids turns out to be a total disaster, they are irrepressible in producing new ideas on how to have fun. the kids are discussing every single decision and plan in front of the cameras just like their adult versions, being a part of a reality show.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Gumball Darwin and Carrie team up to convince their fellow students that the school is haunted. At Halloween show and tell the class isn't buying Gumball's story about Gargaroth The Devourer until Carrie fakes a terrifying haunting. The kids convince the school to hire them as ghost exterminators and take their payment in Halloween candy. But when it turns out Gargaroth is real suddenly Gumball is expected to be the town's saviour.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Gumball is walking in the same direction as Hot Dog Guy and with each step it becomes increasingly awkward. Gumball is too busy singing about ketchup to notice he's about to bump into Hot Dog Guy. They manage to get through an awkward moment only to discover they're travelling in the same direction. Their journey becomes increasingly awkward until a delusional mall cop tries to arrest them and in the process allows them to finally go their separate ways…

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Elmore residents are going missing and the cause of these disappearances may be closer to home than Gumball and Darwin think. A breaking news report tells the Wattersons that their neighbour is among the several mysterious disappearances happening across Elmore. Their search for clues leads them to find a strange egg which they soon discover belongs to their own Evil Turtle. The family realise that it's their responsibility to track down their pet before she and her brood do more damage to the town.

programme.desc: Mech-Max builds a slushy van and Jason tries to prove he's the most extreme.

programme.desc: What started off as a training exercise turns into a real crime as JustJason ends up being a criminal accomplice. Bytz then challenges the entire city to a massivegame of dodgeball, to take his game to the next level.

programme.title: Lana Longbeard
programme.desc: Lana is a super-feisty, forward-thinking and passionate 11-year-old girl, who is also the heir to her father's adventuring ship, the Mighty Windbreaker. Along with her captain dad and his diverse crew (an orc, a dwarf, a barbarian and a cyclops), she sails across the Ten Realms, dreaming of becoming one of the greatest adventurers of all time. But first, she must overcome some challenging obstacles: impulsivity, stubbornness, extreme curiosity, disdain for rules … and a love of pancakes. All the best things about her!

programme.title: Adventure Time
programme.desc: Adventure Time is an American fantasy animated television series that shows a 12-year-old boy Finn and his best friend, a wise 28-year-old (in dog years) dog Jake with magical powers living in Lands of Ooo in post-apocalyptic world. They lean on each other during good and bad times, trust each another with secrets and look to each other for advice. Finn likes to travel and save princesses from evil monsters in Lands of Ooo. Jake is more than his friend, he is his mentor, and his extraordinary skills help the boy to fight evil. Finn and Jake hang out with Princess Bubblegum, the sovereign of the Candy Kingdom, the fearsome Ice King, an ice wizard, Marceline the Vampire Queen, a 1000-year-old vampire and rock musician and many more.

programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin agree to do all of Tobias's chores in exchange for good points! Gumball and Darwin discover that Tobias is doing way better than them in an online game called Galatrek. Tobias admits he earns "good points" doing chores for his parents which he then exchanges for dollars to buy cool stuff for Galatrek. If Gumball and Darwin do Tobias' chores they can earn his "good points" and use them for Galatrek. Gumball and Darwin think they've hit the jackpot. programme.title: Adventure Time
programme.desc: Adventure Time is an American fantasy animated television series that shows a 12-year-old boy Finn and his best friend, a wise 28-year-old (in dog years) dog Jake with magical powers living in Lands of Ooo in post-apocalyptic world. They lean on each other during good and bad times, trust each another with secrets and look to each other for advice. Finn likes to travel and save princesses from evil monsters in Lands of Ooo. Jake is more than his friend, he is his mentor, and his extraordinary skills help the boy to fight evil. Finn and Jake hang out with Princess Bubblegum, the sovereign of the Candy Kingdom, the fearsome Ice King, an ice wizard, Marceline the Vampire Queen, a 1000-year-old vampire and rock musician and many more.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: Lista de Deseos
programme.desc: Bucket List is a travel program entirely dedicated to Japan, a wonderful country with unique culture and traditions, volcanoes, cuisine, lifestyle, and amazing people. Paddy Doherty and Daniel Coll are active in the British and Irish media, visit Japan and experience various things in each region, while encountering challenges that make them confront their own phobias and fears. The viewers who are not yet familiar with Japan will put it on their bucket list and eventually come to visit and see the one-of-a-kind localities themselves.

programme.title: 10 days Sweden
programme.desc: Robbie steps into a fairytale on the island of Gotland — medieval walls, mysterious lagoons, and rugged beauty collide in this windswept wonderland.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: For many years passion for travelling has been bringing people to unexplored continents, countries and places to look into culture, history, food, nature and people. This kind of passion if the key point of Backpack, a travel show that opens new spots all over the world by a show host travelling solo with a backpack. So make yourself comfortable and enjoy visiting Serbia, Spain, Israel, India, Egypt and many more. Take a look at the historical past and modern life, find out about traditions, get to know tourism hotspots and treasures of nature, plan your future vacations with the help of show hosts' recommendations.

programme.title: Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Great World Hotels takes you on a journey to the some of the world's most luxurious hotels and resorts. We visit everything from your own personal lagoon island huts, the size of mansions, to the largest, most decadent penthouse in New York City. Live life like the stars as we explore every corner of the world from the comfort of your sofa. Season one alone takes us from Dubai to Mauritius to the Maldives. Whether you're an avid traveller or have never left the country, this journey is suitable for everyone. This is your journey. This is our journey.

programme.title: Xplore Cambodia
programme.desc: Xplore Cambodia on Travelxp opens an exotic country for the viewers. Together with the host discover Cambodian modern history and traditions.

programme.title: Papad Mammad
programme.desc: Papad ja Mammad sõidavad maale, et lapsed saaks linnas rahulikult elu korda seada. Selgub, et Mitskin on hakanud oma kodu välja rentima ja seal peatub kummaline kirjanik Stella, kes võtab Jüri sihikule. Volli peab sooritama jaoskonnas psüühilise tervise teste. Ulla keelab Jüril Stellaga suhtlemise. Stella kättemaks on jõhker ja Jürit ootab suur jama.

programme.title: Kälimehed
programme.desc: Telelavastuse tegevus toimub ühe vaikse Eesti linnakese vaiksel kõrvaltänaval. Vaikelu saab aga rikutud, kui Urmase ja Riina kõrvalmajja kolib Riina õde Rebekka koos oma uue mehe Raivoga. Saatuse tahtel naabriteks ja kälimeesteks saanud Urmas ja Raivo on inimestena erinevad ning nende õdedest elukaaslased omavahel nagistanud lapsest saadik. Lavastuses näeme, kuidas üleaedsed peavad lahendama igale eestlasele nii tuttavaid probleeme naabrite läbikäimises ning mismoodi aitavad sellele kaasa õdede ellu sekkuv ema ning Raivo hämaravõitu äripartner Viks. Mängivad Peeter Oja, Sepo Seeman, Merle Palmiste, Hilje Murel, Ene Järvis, Andrus Vaarik, Jan Uuspõld, Ivo Eensalu jpt.

programme.title: Kättemaksukontor
programme.desc: Nukuteatris, otse laval ja etenduse ajal, tapetakse näitleja. Seda näevad pealt kümned silmapaarid ja ometi on võimatu kindlaks määrata süüdlast. Seekord tuleb Kättemaksukontoril tegeleda peaaegu saatanliku juhtumiga, kuid õnneks ei usu Frida üleloomulikesse jõududesse.

programme.title: Kerge elu
programme.desc: Toomas ja tema naine Stella elavad koos oma kahe teismelise lapsega pealtnäha unistuste elu. Keegi ei või arvatagi, et pereisal on minevikust kahe miljoni suurune käendusvõlg ja et seda peret hoitakse üleval ainult kuritegevusega. Kui aga Toomasele tuleb pakkumine osaleda suures raharöövis, ei aima veel keegi, kui halvasti asjad minema hakkavad. Osades Margus Prangel, Helena Merzin, Mirjam Aimla ja Siim Sups. Režissöör Raoul Suvi, stsenarist Mikko Pölla.

programme.title: Tulsa kuningas
programme.desc: Kui New Yorgi maffia jõuguboss Dwight 'Kindral' Manfredi (Sylvester Stallone) pärast 25 aastat trellide tagant vabaneb, pagendatakse ta lõunaosariiki Oklahomasse. Tulsa linnas hakkab ta rajama uut kuritegelikku impeeriumit.

programme.desc: Jüri ja Volli lähevad vereanalüüse tegema, et näha, kellel on parem tervis. Maale tagasi jõudes ootab Jürit vahistamine ja süüdistus vägistamiskatses. Ulla on šokeeritud ja plaanib taas lahutust. Volli üritab asja parandada, aga satub samuti Stella lõksu ning saab kallaletungi süüdistuse. Mammad on mustas masenduses, sest mõlemate mehed istuvad trellide taga ning lahendust ei paista.

programme.title: V.E.R.I
programme.desc: 1995-1997 TV3 eetris jooksnud Eesti esimene haiglasari, kus intriigi hoidsid üleval arstide igapäevane töö ja omavahelised suhted. Sarja kirjutas Peeter Urm, toimetas Mihkel Mutt, režissöör ja produtsent oli Toomas Kirss. Sarjas lõi kaasa Eesti näitlejate absoluutne paremik: Aarne Üksküla, Lembit Ulfsak, Guido Kangur, Ülle Kaljuste, Ita Ever, Ivo Uukkivi, Rita Rätsepp, Mait Malmsten, Kärt Kross, Angelina Semjonova, Triinu Meriste, Mari Lill, Andrus Vaarik, Hans Kaldoja, Dan Põldroos, Eduard Toman, Juhan Ulfsak, Merle Palmiste, Ines Aru, Helene Vannari jpt. Sarja pealkiri V.E.R.I. moodustus sõnadest valu, elu, raha, ilu.

programme.title: Kälimehed
programme.desc: Telelavastuse tegevus toimub ühe vaikse Eesti linnakese vaiksel kõrvaltänaval. Vaikelu saab aga rikutud, kui Urmase ja Riina kõrvalmajja kolib Riina õde Rebekka koos oma uue mehe Raivoga. Saatuse tahtel naabriteks ja kälimeesteks saanud Urmas ja Raivo on inimestena erinevad ning nende õdedest elukaaslased omavahel nagistanud lapsest saadik. Lavastuses näeme, kuidas üleaedsed peavad lahendama igale eestlasele nii tuttavaid probleeme naabrite läbikäimises ning mismoodi aitavad sellele kaasa õdede ellu sekkuv ema ning Raivo hämaravõitu äripartner Viks. Mängivad Peeter Oja, Sepo Seeman, Merle Palmiste, Hilje Murel, Ene Järvis, Andrus Vaarik, Jan Uuspõld, Ivo Eensalu jpt.

programme.desc: FBI kõige kogenumatest uurijatest ning profileerijatest koostatud meeskond lahendab ränki kuritegusid, mis esmapilgul tunduvad väljapääsmatult keerukad. Meeskonna iga liige on oma valdkonna tipp ning üksteist täendades pole ükski kuritegu neile lahendamatu.

programme.title: Mõrvaennetajad
programme.desc: Avahooajal USAs laineid löönud põnevussari salapärasest miljardärist, kes värbab endale appi endise CIA agendi, et ühiselt ennetada New Yorki ähvardavaid ränki kuritegusid. Pururikas geenius Finch ("Teadmata kadunud" staar Michael Emerson) on välja töötanud arvutiprogrammi, mis suudab tuvastada potentsiaalse mõrvari või tema ohvri veel enne selle kuriteo reaalset toimumist. Endine eriagent Reese (Jim Caviezel), kes pärast isiklikku tragöödiat elab New Yorkis kodutuna, on nõus Fichiga kampa lööma ja aitab Finchil huvipakkuva isiku üles leida. Reese'i ülesandeks jääb ka tulevase tapja kahjutuks tegemine. Loomulikult peab tandem tegutsema ülima saladuskatte all, sest nende info ja tegevuse paljastamise tagajärjed oleksid katastroofilised.

programme.title: Chicago politseijaoskond
programme.desc: Pärast bioterrorismi kahtlusaluse tuvastamist valmistub politsei oma seni suurimaks inimjahiks. Upton tahab aidata süüdlast leida, aga samas ka pakkuda emotsionaalset tuge hirmunud tüdrukule, kes teda vajab.

programme.title: Vendade Hardyde müsteeriumid
programme.desc: Hirmuäratav mees jälitab Joed karnevalile. Frank püüab välja selgitada, miks Laura vana kaevanduse kokkuvarisemise vastu nii suurt huvi tundis.

programme.desc: Pärast seda, kui kahtlased uimastid röövivad kahe koolipoisi elu, tuleb uurijail kiiresti tabada diilerid enne, kui ka teiste õpilaste elud ohus on. Rustyl tuleb suur otsus teha.

programme.title: Monk
programme.desc: Monki veokijuhist isa Jack satub enne jõulupühi San Franciscosse ning ta otsustab poja juurest läbi hüpata. Kui aga meesteni jõuab uudis Jacki ülemuse mõrvast, ühendavad isa ja poeg jõud, et üheskoos tapja tabada ning samas ka teineteist veidi paremini tundma õppida.

programme.title: Kas me oleme juba kohal?
programme.desc: Noormees tutvub kaunitariga, kes osutub kahe lapsega lahutatud üksikemaks. Lapsed on kategooriliselt ema potentsiaalse poiss-sõbra vastu. Nende ettekujutustes peaks ema nende isaga kokku jääma.

programme.title: Eriliselt kangelaslik film
programme.desc: Üks tavaline abiturient omandab ootamatult üleloomulikud võimed. Endine hädavares, kes on loomult heatahtlik ja abivalmis, otsustab hakata superkangelaseks. Nüüd hakkab ta võitlema kurjusega.

programme.title: Kuu parim töötaja
programme.desc: Kastitassija Zack Bradley ja kassapidaja Vince Downey on kaks supermarketi rivaalitsevat töötajat. Vince on saanud peakassiiriks ning valiti 17 korda järjest kuu parimaks töötajaks. Zack on igavene lohe, aga oma kollegide hulgas hinnatud mees. Kui tööle saabub uus kassapidaja, silmipimestavalt kaunis ja seksikas Amy, muutub poes kõik. Zack ja Vince hakkavad võyitlema Amy tähelepanu nimel. Vince võlub naist oma kassapidamisoskuste ja auhindadega, Zack püüab võita Amy poolehoidu oma sarmi ja naljadega.

programme.title: Esimene aasta
programme.desc: See film viib meid eelajaloolisse aega ning pajatab kahest parimast sõbrast, Zedist ja Ohist. See ebatavaline paar satub alatihti kõiksugu probleemide ja sekelduste keskele.

programme.title: Farmi peoloomad
programme.desc: Kui farmer on ära, siis kõik loomad mängivad, laulavad ja tantsivad. Lõpuks peab aga keegi sekkuma ja juhtimise üle võtma ning vastutus jääb muretu lehma Otise kanda.

programme.title: Seersant Bilko
programme.desc: Tõeline intrigant seersant Bilko on oma koloneli täiesti ümber oma sõrme keeranud: ta teatab, et katsetab uutmoodi tanki ehitamist, tegelikult aga tegeleb kaartide ja teiste hasartmängudega.

programme.title: Kondimurdjad
programme.desc: Komöödia vangidest, kes teevad jalgpallimeeskonna, et valvuritega jõudu katsuda.

programme.title: Peeter Pikk-kõrv: jänes jooksus
programme.desc: Armastusväärne võrukael Peeter Pikk-kõrv jõuab järjefilmis taas kinolinale. Bea, Thomas ja jänesed on ajutise perekonna moodustanud, kuid vaatamata pingutustele ei suuda Peeter üleannetu jänku mainest vabaneda. Aiast välja sattudes leiab Peeter end maailmast, kus tema ulakusi hinnatakse. Kui aga pere teda otsima asudes kõigega riskib, peab Peeter selgusele jõudma, milline jänku ta olla tahab.

programme.title: Koerte hotell
programme.desc: Mahajäetud hotell, kuhu on kolinud hulkuvad koerad, jääb silma kahele lapsele. Neil ei lubata koeri koju tuua ja nad otsustavad teha koerale oma kodu, kus saaksid elada kõik kodutud koerad.

programme.title: Norbit
programme.desc: USA 2007 komöödia Lavastaja: Brian Robbins Osades: Eddie Murphy, Thandie Newton, Terry Crews, Cuba Gooding Jr. Norbit (Eddie Murphy) on orb, kes kasvas üles hr. Wongi (Eddie Murphy) restoranis ja lastekodus. Saatus viis ta lahku hingesugulasest, armsast Kate'ist (Thandie Newton), ning nüüd vaevleb vaene mees Rasputia (Eddie Murphy!) tuhvli all, unistades paremast elust kuskil mujal, kellegi teise kõrval. Pärast seda, kui Kate ootamatult uuesti välja ilmub, tekib Norbiti hinges naiivne lootus, et võib-olla on see võimalik.

programme.title: Õhus
programme.desc: USA 2009 romantiline komöödia Lavastaja: Jason Reitman Osades: George Clooney, Vera Farmiga, Anna Kendrick, Jason Bateman Ryan Bingham (George Clooney) veedab enamuse oma ajast mööda Ühendriike ringi lennates ja inimesi vallandades - see on mehe elukutse, milles on ta lausa põrgulikult hea. Tema ideaalne karjäär aga ähvardab kokku variseda, kui firma palkab tööle noore naise Alexi (Vera Farmiga), kes tuleb lagedale uue innovaatilise lahendusega: hakata inimesi vallandama läbi Interneti. Päästmaks enda karjääri, otsustab Ryan teha kõik võimaliku, et Alexi idee ei teostuks.
